directive_from_owner: Forget about the benchmarks for a moment; focus on the capabilities. Delete the benchmarks as a scarce limiting factor. The benchmarks' job is just to evaluate our capabilities so we can make our tests by ourselves. They are not sacred, but our tests must be totally true.

decisions.text: External benchmarks (private, unrunnable or replay-forbidden) are removed from the list of limiting factors. They are optional evaluation, never a prerequisite for calling something a capability.

The acceptance currency for the word 'capability' is a fresh-instance receipt under canonical/laws/TRUE_CAPABILITY_TEST_LAW_V1.md: unseen instances, independent oracle, zero model, network blocked, hidden seed, separated solver/generator/oracle files.
Receipts carry authority NONE. Credit requires MEASURED_PUBLIC_RUNNER status plus admission by the referee on main (REPO_INTEGRITY_POLICY_V1).
Routes that depend on an external model (GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, Codex, Wolfram cloud) are not Brain capabilities and are not eligible for a spec under this law.
Checker-gaming solvers (output-shape satisfiers such as the LiveBench IF filler compiler) are not eligible for a spec under this law.
Existing acceptance predicates, evidence bindings, goal pointers and benchmark counts are not modified by this pivot. No credit is added or removed.
